name: base_utils
description: Manages common Linux utilities, including an optional /etc/motd file and configurable utility packages. It also provides supporting custom types, functions, facts, Bolt plans, and tasks.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Prepares and deploys a Python application stack, including runtime dependencies, application code, PostgreSQL connectivity, service configuration, systemd management, logging, health checks, backups, and monitoring.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures HAProxy with frontend and backend settings, optional backend discovery, health checks, statistics, TLS, firewall integration, and service management.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL by managing the PGDG repository, versioned packages, and the PostgreSQL service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures Redis nodes with password protection, persistence, memory policy, bind and port settings, and PuppetDB-based discovery for cluster-related information.
